name: Cecilia Choi
bio: Cecilia Choi Sze-wan is a Hong Kong actress. She is known for playing the key supporting role in Detention and the leading role in Beyond the Dream, for which she won for the Best Actress award at the 26th Hong Kong Film Critics Society Awards and was nominated for Best Actress at 39th Hong Kong Film Awards.
